specs.scene: A single person is positioned hard left, seated at a narrow worktable, hands mid-motion linking two glowing nodes on a blank interactive surface in front of them; the right half of the frame is clean, softly lit, and empty, drawing the eye toward the number floating there.
specs.source_quote: seven to twelve thousand dollars a month combined

hero.why: One clear dollar figure dominates, no competing numbers, reads instantly at small size.

stakes.why: Directly implies the viewer could replace a salary with just two clients, a personal financial stake.

complement.why: No word or number in the overlay appears in any of the three title options.

curiosity.why: Viewer can see money and a builder but not what is being automated or for whom, leaving a real question.

subject.why: Person mid-action at a workstation is a concrete anchor, though the action itself is somewhat generic.

unrepeatable.why: The dollar range and generic building motion could plausibly appear in other freelance-income episodes.

legibility.why: Single figure, blank right half, and a clear seated silhouette hold up well at 120px.

specs.scene: A single vintage rotary telephone sits alone on a blank pedestal at center-right, its coiled cord trailing off the edge of frame, a faint warm glow around the receiver, the background a smooth, empty gradient with no other objects or people present.
specs.source_quote: monthly retainer of five hundred to five thousand

hero.why: One unambiguous recurring-revenue figure anchors the frame with nothing competing for attention.

stakes.why: Recurring monthly income is the clearest personal-gain stake in the whole inventory.

complement.why: Neither the object nor the numeral overlaps any word in the title options.

curiosity.why: A phone paired with a retainer figure raises an unanswered question about what service is actually being sold.

subject.why: A single, distinctive object with no clutter is exactly the kind of anchor the dimension rewards.

unrepeatable.why: The dial-tone framing is a specific metaphor pulled directly from this script's own language.

legibility.why: One object on a blank field with a short overlay is maximally legible at thumbnail size.

specs.scene: Two people face each other across a narrow table, one gesturing toward a blank glowing panel suspended between them while the other leans in to inspect it, plain walls and even lighting behind both figures with no other props in frame.
specs.source_quote: fifteen hundred to five thousand dollars for a simple workflow

hero.why: One number is present but the two-person frame slightly dilutes single-figure dominance.

stakes.why: Gives the viewer a concrete number to anchor their own pricing, a practical personal stake.

complement.why: No shared words or numerals with any title option.

curiosity.why: Viewer can guess a sale is happening but not what the workflow does or why the price varies.

subject.why: Two-shot tension is present but splits attention rather than giving one unmistakable anchor.

unrepeatable.why: A generic pitch-meeting scene with a price tag could belong to almost any service-selling episode.

legibility.why: Two faces and a panel are more crowded than a single anchor, slightly reducing small-size clarity.

specs.scene: A wide, open marketplace floor stretches into the distance, lined with rows of identical blank kiosks under even overhead light, no people or props breaking the symmetry, the vanishing point drawing the eye toward empty space at the far end of the hall.
specs.source_quote: fourteen and twenty-three billion dollars in 2026

hero.why: One percentage figure is present and uncontested, though environmental shots dilute figure dominance somewhat.

unrepeatable.why: A generic market-size statistic and empty hall could illustrate almost any growing-industry episode.
